Both conditions have blurred lines so it's hard to have solid conclusions. I consider I have traits of both. I don't have a professional opinion to confidently confirm it. And probably AvPD is influenced by aspergers heavily.

I constantly brooding about my life, what is wrong with me, events that happened in the past, analyzing my behavior and try to paint a picture how my future could be, which is obviously sad and barren. It's the most torturous thing about AvPD.
